articleTitle: Effective prediction of three common diseases by combining SMOTE with Tomek links technique for imbalanced medical data
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Diabetes, vertebral column pathologies and Parkinson's disease are three common diseases which have high prevalence and brought great trouble and pain to billions of patients. Computer aided diagnosis can support decision making of physicians. However, imbalanced nature of data sets hampered the mining of medical resources. In this study, we proposed a powerful preprocessing method by combining Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) with Tomek links technique and then is applied to the imbalanced medical data sets of the three diseases. By using 8 classifiers, we compared the experimental results with those of using only SMOTE technique to evaluate the effectiveness of this method. The results show that the method of SMOTE combined with Tomek links technique is much superior compared with that of using only SMOTE. The performances are evidently better, with 31, 27, 30 out of a total of 32 evaluation metrics are improved for diabetes, Parkinson's disease, and vertebral column, respectively.

articleTitle: An improved network traffic classification algorithm based on Hadoop decision tree
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In the current age of the Internet, network traffic increased exponentially, either based on user demand for network resources, QoS scheduling, or according to the development trend of network applications for expansion transformation of the existing network, various applications in network traffic need to be classified and identified accurately, network traffic classification is particularly important. C4.5 decision tree algorithm as a commonly used supervised classification algorithm is often applied in traffic classification, but with the increase of data volume, the efficiency of C4.5 algorithm has been reduced. Hadoop platform as open source cloud framework, in dealing with big data has a high performance, so in many cases as the preferred handle large data. On the basis of the original C4.5 algorithm, the improved algorithm is simplified, and the algorithm is parallel to the Hadoop platform, I call it HAC4.5 decision tree algorithm. Experiments show that the improved HAC4.5 decision tree algorithm not only improves the running speed, but also improves the accuracy of the calculation.

articleTitle: Provenance cloud security auditing system based on log analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud computing and distributed system, the security of data stored in cloud server becomes more and more important. In this paper, we analyze the challenges and problems of clouding security, and introduce the cloud security framework, as well as compare the different cloud security controlling methods. Meanwhile, we propose our own trusted cloud framework based on Cloud Accountability Life Cycle. To satisfy the requirements of cloud security, auditing the provenance data in cloud server is the most efficient method, and the log is a type of provenance data, which is relative easy and stable to collect. Therefore, audit based on log data plays a significant role in cloud security framework. In this paper, we also compare different security audit mechanisms, and point out their advantages and disadvantages as well as suggest how to improve these mechanisms.

articleTitle: Predicting the silicon content of the hot metal based on dynamic neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper introduces a real time method of predicting the silicon content of the hot metal based on improved Elman net. With preserving most character of original data, this method can eliminate the relativity of sample data, simplify net structure, and then realize the predicting of the silicon content online. The hit rate reached 89.57% in the predicting experiments of a blast furnace on Bao Steel with error ranging from -0.05 to 0.05.

articleTitle: An accurate frequency offset estimator in the intermediate frequency for the satellite-based AIS signals
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper investigates an accurate frequency offset estimator in the intermediate frequency for the satellite-based AIS signals. Using Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying (GMSK) modulation for transmission, the AIS signal is shown to be a plane wave with the modulated phase information and carrier frequency resulting from the Doppler effects. Hence, the phase information can be eliminated with a re-modulated signal, and the frequency offset can be estimated by the ratio of the maximum spectral amplitude and its neighbor spectral amplitude based on the FFT interpolation. The estimator has low complexity, and it is easy to implement. Computer simulations are used to assess the estimation performance of the estimator.

articleTitle: A study of student information management software
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: As a man-machine system that utilizes computer software & hardware resources and database, MIS (Management Information System) can provide information to support the operation, management and decision-making functions of enterprises or organizations. With the continuous scale expansion of colleges and universities, the number of students has increased. Dramatically and various students-related information contents are also doubled. In the face of huge amount of information, it is required to possess the student information management system to improve the efficiency of student management. Through this system, the standardized management, scientific statistics and fast query of student information can be realized, and thus the workload of management can be reduced. In this paper, a typical student information management system will be established to realize the systematization, standardization and automation of student information relationship.

articleTitle: An improvement on recurrent neural network by combining convolution neural network and a simple initialization of the weights
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Recently, the Recurrent Neural Network(RNN) has become a very powerful tool in deep learning to solve different tasks. It is considered as a viable alternative to the deep convolution neural networks. However, we all know it is a difficult task for RNN to learn long term dependencies due to vanishing and exploding gradients. The most famous and successful structure we know is Long Short Term Memory(LSTM). In this paper, we proposed a novel architecture combining Convolution Neural Network(CNN) and a variation of an RNN which is composed of Rectified Linear Units(ReLUs) and initialized with the identity matrix. We conclude that our architecture can reduce optimization time significantly and achieve a better performance compared to original neural networks on two widely-used datasets: MNIST and IMDB. Our study proves that there is still a lot of margin for the improvement of Recurrent Neural Networks.

articleTitle: The research of concept extraction in ontology extension based on extended association rules
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Ontology extension is to achieve the purpose of expanding ontology by adding new concepts and the relationship between concepts to the existing ontology. In this paper, we proposed a new method to automatically extract concept from text collection and attach them with existing ontology. We mainly use the weighted association rules to mine latent concepts from the unstructured text. Then, according to the TF-IDF value of the concept, we determine a set of the weights of the weighted association rules. At the same time, on the basis of the semantic similarity between concepts in the initial ontology to be expanded, the minimum support in the association rules is determined. This method can improve the efficiency and accuracy of domain concept extraction. We compare our new method with TF-IDF on data sets. Experiment results show that our method outperforms TF-IDF in terms of accuracy and provides better ontology description.

articleTitle: Efficient association rule mining algorithm based on user behavior for cloud security auditing
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Cloud Storage provides external data storage service by combing and coordinating different types of storage devices in the network, so that they can collectively work together. However it always exists a trust game relationship between users and service providers, therefore building a healthy, fair and secure cloud data service environment is necessary, especially for the security auditing on the state of cloud data and operation processes. This paper proposes user behavior (UB)-based scheme, by analyzing log data from cloud servers. Firstly, we present the description rules of UB for operating system logs. Then we put forward an association rule mining algorithm based on the Long Sequence Frequent Pattern (LSFP) to extract UB. At last, the result of experiment proves that our solution can implement the track and forensic of data leakage efficiently for the cloud security auditing.

articleTitle: Evolution of service composition based on QoS under the cloud computing environment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In order to select efficiently cloud services to meet user service request in service composition evolution process under the cloud computing environment, the paper proposes an strategy of cloud service composition evolution based on hybrid particle swarm. First, we explore and describe evaluation standards and calculation expressions for the quality of cloud services under the cloud computing environment. Second, we transform the problem into a multi-objective programming problem of cloud service composition evolution. Finally we design a hybrid particle swarm algorithm to solve it. Our method can provide high quality and efficient services for requests under the cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Association rule-based feature selection for credit risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Credit risk assessment becomes rapidly important for credit department of the bank to determine whether to issue credit cards, and make loans to both companies and individualities. However, due to the complexity of database, it is arduous for credit managers to make decisions. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a framework that combines feature selection and decision tree classification for credit risk assessment. The feature selection is based on association rules mining. The empirical result shows that our approach can not only reduce the data dimensionality significantly but also provide higher classification accuracies than other methods.

articleTitle: Study on no-load loss of amorphous alloy control transformer based on the finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The current control transformer on the market still continues the manufacturing process of traditional power transformer, silicon steel sheet as the main magnetic material has disadvantages of low energy efficiency and their own large loss. This paper analyzes the amorphous alloy used to manufacturing performance and energy-saving advantages of control transformer by Ansoft, focusing on the analysis of the spatial distribution of magnetic field lines and loss situation in a weak alternating magnetic field, which provide scientific basis for the widely application of amorphous alloy material in the control transformer.

articleTitle: Removing thin cloud on single remote sensing image based on SWF
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Satellite remote sensing image is often covered with thin cloud. In this paper, support vector value filter is used to decompose thin cloud-contaminated remote sensing image into multi-resolution subband coefficients. Through suppressing the low frequency coefficients, thin cloud is removed effectively and ground object information is preserved sufficiently. Comparing with other thin cloud removal methods, support vector value filter has advantages of good generalization and strongly catching singularity ability. Experiments show that the proposed method can effectively recover the ground object information of remote sensing image covered with thin cloud and obtain ideal cloud-free image.

articleTitle: An enhanced greedy perimeter stateless routing algorithm for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the defects of the Greedy Perimeter Stateless Routing (GPSR) and makes improvement, puts forward a new Enhanced Greedy Perimeter Stateless Routing (EGPSR) Algorithm. In this algorithm, on the basis of the remaining energy of the neighboring nodes, the forward region is uniformly divided into four subregions. Then the region with minimal energy variance is chosen as the routing selected region. Finally, the probability mechanism is applied in the chosen forward region to select the next hop node. Simulation experiment shows the EGPSR algorithm can effectively balance the network nodes energy and accordingly prolong the network life cycle.

articleTitle: A detection method of road traffic sign based on inverse perspective transform
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Rapidly and accurately detection of road surface traffic signs, and it be send to the driver in real time are not only can guarantee the safety of driving, but also to avoid the occurrence of traffic accidents. So, it is important to study the driving assistance system. In this paper, a detection method of road traffic sign based on inverse perspective transform was presented. The method handles the image acquired from camera, and the image was processed by the inverse perspective transform. It makes the original deformation of road traffic signs seriously to be corrected, and provides reliable data for the subsequent recognition of traffic signs. Experimental results show that this method was robust.

articleTitle: An algorithm for the Jordan canonical form and the transition matrix
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The Jordan canonical form and transition matrix of Frobenius matrices are given by this paper. Basing on the common matrix becomes to a rational canonical form under the elementary transformation of the similar constraints, and we can get a new calculation method for solving transition matrix and using the elementary transformation of matrix to make general matrix to the Jordan canonical form. And in this paper, we give an algorithm for the Jordan canonical form and the transition matrix, these knowledge are based on Jordan canonical form and the elementary transformation under the similar constraints.

articleTitle: Gradient and SVM based biometric identification using human body communication
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: To investigate biometric identification based on human body communication at 300KHz-1.5GHz. A feasibility study was done with 10 volunteers including 6 men and 4 women. The age range of the volunteers is 23-27 years, weigh 45-75 kilogram, and stand 153-180 centimeter in, all volunteers are healthy. The measurement was done 9 times in 3 days, and a total 2,880,000 measurement data has been obtained. Matrix transform was employed to extract gradient from measurement data. The gradients as an individual trait were analyzed by support vector machines (SVM) including C-SVM and nu-SVM with linear function, polynomial, and radial basis function (RBF) as kernel function. Our experimental results show that, when the C-SVM with RBF as kernel function is used, the correct identification rate (CIR) of 99.5% is achieved, the area under the curve (AUC) of receiver operating characteristic (ROC) reaches 0.9999 and the equal error rate (EER) is 0.11%.

articleTitle: Introduction to distributed photovoltaic power generation flexible grid-connection interface equipment research
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The distributed grid connected photovoltaic power interface device of distributed photovoltaic power generation equipment of relay protection, measurement and control, remote control, power quality, harmonic governance function realization of integrated, unified management, used to connect the distributed photovoltaic power generation system and power grid, to realize the unified management of the distributed photovoltaic, is plug and an important technical means for the implementation of “plug and play” distributed photovoltaic power generation. The device is an important carrier of the Power Grid Corp distributed photovoltaic power grid work standardization management, facilitate the Power Grid Corp of the distributed grid connected photovoltaic power management, supervision and services. This product will promote the integrated, intelligent and standardized management of distributed photovoltaic power generation in China, a large-scale application to distributed photovoltaic power generation, to promote the construction of “green smart grid”.

articleTitle: Opportunistic routing for heterogeneous micro-power network in smart grids
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Future communication networks of smart girds will consist of a mixture legacy of wireless and PLC links using heterogeneous technologies. In this paper we investigate the feasibility of Opportunistic Routing (OR) use to deliver packets in such a heterogeneous network and propose a custom OR for it which uses static geographical information. For doing this, we first introduce Dijkstra's algorithm to select a single link between the source and the destination for routing unicast packets. Then the forward sets for each nodes on the link is chosen according to the hops away from the source node. At last, we make a comparison between OR and sequential routing with respect to the number of transmissions and end-to-end delay.

articleTitle: A real-time cigarettes counting and loose ends detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In industrial application of cigarette detection, lack of cigarettes and loose end problems are widely exist. The proposed work presents a vision-based cigarettes detection algorithm which allows lack of cigarettes and loose end problems being detected in real-time. Firstly, image segmentation and morphological operation are introduced to distinguish cigarettes region and background. Three-line model is then applied to locate each cigarette. After that, centers of each cigarette are found. At last, by counting the number of pixels in each obtained area, the likelihood of lack of cigarettes and loose end problems are given. The experiment results illustrate that proposed algorithm has high recognition rate in both lack of cigarettes and loose ends detection while it could operate in real-time.

articleTitle: RRM-B: Reliable retransmission mechanism for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is a multi-hop self-organization formed by a lot of energy-limited sensor nodes. It is widely used in security surveillance, intelligent transportation, smart home, environmental monitoring and so on. The mechanism of data is the important part of the wireless sensor network. However, due to the limit sensor energy and poor channel quality, The reliability of the transmission cannot meet the requirements, so how to ensure the reliable data to the destination node is key point of the wireless sensor network. Data retransmission can improve the reliability of transmission for Wireless sensor network. For this, we introduce a reliability routing protocol based on information calculate algorithm model. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is energy saving, not only reducing the packet drop rate over networks, but also improving effectively the network transport fairness and the average network latency.

articleTitle: A methodology for palm vein image enhancement and visualization
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Palm vein recognition is a developing biometric identification technology. It can be used in physical security and information security for selective control of access to a place or resource. Prior to the palm vein recognition, vein enhancement is generally required for a better recognition. In this paper, we propose a vein enhancement method combining Karhunen-Loeve (KL) transform and hue-preserving color image enhancement technology. Experimental results show that the proposed method is robust to shadow affect, can give better visualization results, and can significantly improve the contrast and contour details of image (the contrast ratio increases by 2.3%, edge intensity increases by 8.8%, and definition increases by 66.9%) comparing to the traditional enhancement methods.

articleTitle: Prospect of application of physical layer network coding in deep space communication
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: With the development of deep space exploration, data transmission task is getting heavier and heavier. Physical Layer Network Coding (PNC), as a new kind of frequency multiplexing transmission technology, can improve the system throughput and spectral efficiency by making use of the additive nature of simultaneously arriving electromagnetic waves for equivalent network coding operation in wireless cooperative environments, which meets the increasing requirements of data transmission capacity in deep space missions. In this paper, the basic principles of PNC were firstly introduced. Second, its benefits over traditional forward and straight forward network coding under two-way relay scenario were illustrated. Then, the applications of PNC in deep space communication were proposed. Finally, it was pointed out that PNC had good development trend in the deep space communication. But some technical difficult problems must be solved in practical project application for future deep space exploration.

articleTitle: Library personalized information recommendation of big data
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Library personalized information recommendation of big data had becoming an important research task increasingly as the time goes by. The traditional library information recommendation could not satisfy library and users' needs. The paper divided the users into advanced users and ordinary users. The library personalized information recommendation methods and strategy of big data were presented. The experimental results show that the proposed methods and strategy are effective.

articleTitle: An edge enhancement method of radiographic weld image using bidimensional empirical mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The edge and detail of radiographic weld images are fuzzy, resulting in that it is difficult to segment and recognize defects on them. So, an edge enhancement method of radiographic weld image using bidimensional empirical mode decomposition (RIEM) is proposed in this paper. In this method, first, we decompose a radiographic weld image to get its high frequency components by the bidimensional empirical mode decomposition (BEMD). Then, we perform an appropriate edge enhancement operation to the original image using high frequency information weighting, and the weighting coefficient is determined by the average detail variance (DV) and the average background variance (BV). Finally, the enhanced image with clearer edge and detail can be obtained. Experimental results show that RIEM can enhance edge and detail of the radiographic weld image effectively while maintaining its background information well.

articleTitle: Research on the influence factors of asphalt rubber mixture fatigue performance
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The three-point-bending-fatigue-loading test is adopted to study the influence factors of asphalt rubber mixture fatigue performance. To research the effect that asphalt content and air voids have on asphalt rubber mixture fatigue performance, AC-13 mixture and SMA-13 mixture are selected to be tested under different conditions. In addition, the effect that aging time has on AC-13 mixture and fiber content on SMA-13 mixture is also studied. Studies show that the fatigue life of asphalt rubber mixture first increases with the asphalt content then decreases with it, which means that there is an optimum asphalt content. Within the normal extent of air voids, the decrease of air voids can improve the fatigue life. Aging makes fatigue life of AC-13 mixture decrease, and pre-aging has a little impact on fatigue life while later-aging dramatically reduces the fatigue life. Under various stress ratios, with the increase of fiber content, the fatigue life of SMA-13 mixture first increases and then decreases, the optimum fiber content is 0.4%.

articleTitle: Design of metal detector based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: A kind of metal detector based on single chip microcomputer MSP430 control was developed, whose control core of the detector is the low power consumption microprocessor MSP430. The metal object probe of the detector is LDC1000 inductance/digital converter evaluation board (AY - LDC1000). The detector perceive or measure conductor target position and material composition by inductance sensor. Liquid crystal LCD12864 will display the metal object coordinates. Stepper motor will control the sliding and rotation system. The equipment is easy to implement, which has good reliability, sensitivity and anti-interference. The detector has the very broad application prospects in the field of metal detection.

articleTitle: RAR: Replication adaptive routing in oceanic wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Due to the intermittent connectivity of oceanic wireless communication, traditional connection-oriented TCP/IP protocols have to stop transmission because of connection interruption. And due to the heterogeneity of oceanic wireless networks, existing protocols cannot directly apply to oceanic wireless networks. Therefore, we designed a Replication Adaptive Routing (RAR) protocol for oceanic wireless networks, considering the heterogeneity and characteristics of oceanic wireless communication. To evaluate the performance of RAR, we implement RAR on a testbed consisting of over 20 wireless nodes. The experimental results have shown that RAR effectively improves data transmission rate and greatly reduce transmission delay, compared with existing TCP/IP protocols.

articleTitle: Novel numerical and computational techniques for remote sensor based monitoring of freshwater quality
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Freshwater protection is one of the key issues for environment protection. In this paper we propose novel techniques to remotely monitor freshwater quality in river system using wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In order to maximize the performance in water quality monitoring with minimum amount of sensor nodes, we have studied optimal sensor deployment algorithm based on graph theory, genetic algorithm (GA) and storm water management model (SWMM). We have also proposed algorithms to automatically detect and locate the pollution and predict the subsequent reaches which will be polluted. For overcoming the power supply limitation of WSNs, both wind and solar power devices are used as a long-term energy source for sensor nodes.

articleTitle: A novel ISM band antenna with frequency selective surface structure
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In this paper, a novel Industrial, Scientific, Medical (ISM) band antenna using organic magnetic substrate antenna with frequency selective surface structure is proposed. In order to minimize the antenna's available area, organic magnetic material substrate is used. To increase the available bandwidth and achieve better performance, frequency selective surface structure is adopted. To verify the validity, a 5.56-6.3 GHz wide band patch antenna is fabricated; the simulation results for operating frequency band are shown to have good agreement with measurements.

articleTitle: Ethernet address resolution in the context of dynamic IP address changes
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: While developing dynamic IP address changing techniques under current TCP/IP protocol cluster, the ARP request and reply messages of dynamic IP addresses must be carefully and effectively handled. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm based on current ARP protocol and switch's self-learning algorithm to address the Ethernet address resolution problem in the context of dynamic IP address changes, which is designed to be deployed in the SDN environment. To evaluate the effectiveness of proposed algorithm, an experimental network was constructed by mininet. The hosts' ARP tables and OpenFlow switches' corresponding mapping tables in the experiment demonstrate that the proposed algorithm could fully satisfy the need of Ethernet address resolution in the context of dynamic IP address changes.

articleTitle: Program performance test based on different computing environment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: To test the efficiency of different programming languages and find out the suitable one for solving the calculation problem of spherical distance between two points, we have developed serial and parallel calculate algorithms according C, Python programming languages, and tested the execution speed of all algorithms. As for the inefficiency of Python, we improved the performance by replacing some functions and variables of Python procedure with Cython. The experimental results show that Python programs can get the same execution efficiency as C language does with the same Large-scale computing environment.

articleTitle: Robust-adaptive-based relative pose synchronous control in space autonomous rendezvous
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: With the development of space exploration technology and space commercial activities, space resources and environment is facing enormous challenges because of the sharp increasing number of spacecraft in space. Space Autonomous Rendezvous (SAR) is a multidisciplinary complex systems engineering. Thus, it has high demands on the precision, reliability, security, and other state constraints. In this paper, the pose synchronization control characteristics are analyzed. Then, the robust-adaptive-based control law is designed, and the feasibilities are proved. After that, via the simulation, pose synchronization control can be achieved with the robust-adaptive-based control law. Finally, the control parameter impact on system is analyzed and the result will help to the control system design.

articleTitle: An improved method about AES and FPGA high-speed realize
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: It is difficult to design to generate a S box with excellent crytographic properties in AES algorithms. So Wu Wenling et al. proposed a new S box. The paper is based on the new S box to realize extension from one set to multiple sets of S boxes by utilizing S box to generate time-shift selection function. And employ the dynamic S box of encryption and decryption scheme to AES advanced encryption algorithm. Then, design the S box on the FPGA platform. The simulation confirms that the method improves the speed of the encryption algorithm and reduces hardware logic unites of the encryption algorithm.

articleTitle: Efficient functional encryption and proxy re-cryptography for secure public cloud data sharing
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: With the rapid development in cloud computing, public cloud data sharing concept has been extending and expanding by many scholars. In 2014, Liang et al. proposed a general notion for proxy re-encryption (PRE), which is called deterministic finite automata-based functional PRE (DFA-based FPRE). Motivated by the issues of efficiency and flexibility associated with this new primitive, we propose outsourcing decryption scheme to increase the flexibility of users by delegating their decryption rights to the semi trusted proxy. Through analysis we showed that our scheme is provably secure and efficient.

articleTitle: Performance of the RDDL planners
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Recently, a new language is proposed to model probabilistic planning. It is the Relational Dynamic Influence Diagram Language (RDDL). There are a few domains, which are described in RDDL until now. However, there are fewer planners for these domains. Most of those planners do not fully support the features of RDDL. These planners are all participated in a competition. However, there are many manually tuning, and the experimental environments are specific. Therefore, in this paper, we try to test those planners on our own platform and without tuning.

articleTitle: Closest neighbors excluded outlier detection
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Traditional distance-based outlier detection usually consider the distances from a point to its nearest neighbors as its outlier degree. In this case, if a few points form a small but dense cluster, which is far from other points, points in this small and dense cluster are not likely to be detected as outliers. In this paper, we propose a new distance-based outlier definition, Closest Neighbors Excluded (CNE) outlier, and the corresponding detection algorithm, which is able to detect dense outliers, as well as sparse outliers. Experimental results show that the CNE algorithm achieves great improvement in accuracy with little cost of efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and development of general data acquisition system based on wireless sensor network dynamic network technology
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In this paper, a general data acquisition system is designed by taking advantage of wireless sensor network dynamic network technology and wireless SoC CC2530. This system on-demand accomplishes the tasks of data acquisition processing transmission by using acquisition nodes which is designed by the universal standard convenient to use various types of sensors. Efficient networking and flexible network scale can be achieved by using of dynamic network technology, and generates the visual display and alarm tints on the embedded monitor. The system belongs to the modular universal design and can be used in different industries as long as making a little modification to shorten the cycle and reduce the cost.

articleTitle: TC-DTN: A TCP compatible DTN overlay protocol
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In Delay/Disruption Tolerant Networks (DTN), where a stable transmission path cannot guarantee due to intermittent connectivity, traditional Internet TCP/IP protocols have a bad performance because they require a continuously stale transmission path. On the other hand, those transmission protocols specially designed for DTN are not compatible with the existing software, which developed based on TCP/IP protocol stack. Therefore, we designed a TCP Compatible DTN (TC-DTN) overlay protocol for oceanic wireless networks, considering the characteristics of oceanic wireless communication. To evaluate the performance of TC-DTN, we implement TC-DTN on a testbed consisting of over 20 wireless nodes. The experimental results have shown that TC-DTN effectively improves data transmission rate and greatly reduce transmission delay, compared with existing TCP/IP protocols.

articleTitle: Key techniques of the digital reservoir data center
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Oil-gas reservoir data center is an important issue in the process of information construction of digital oilfield. In light of the heterogeneous data in oil and gas reservoir and various types of researches and decisions, by setting up the unified data standard and database norm, a digital reservoir data center is established to develop a series of key technologies, such as reservoir data link technology, data service bus technology and software interface technology. With the construction of the reservoir data center which is oriented to the combination of reservoir business flow and data flow, the digital reservoir data center provides integrated, real-time, visual and collaborative exploration and development of oil-gas reservoir business and ensures the efficient operation of reservoir exploration and development which are interdisciplinary, interdepartmental, and trans-regional within the whole oilfield. In addition, the operation and management cost of oil-gas reservoir is reduced.

articleTitle: Research of intelligent substation evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Evaluation of intelligent substation project is an important part of smart grid construction. This article describes the study of the index system of intelligent substation. Intelligent evaluation system substations uses the SMART criteria that World Bank and national governments S & P used, including technical indicators, economic indicators, social indicators, practical indicators, level indicators. It can provide effective protection and guidance for future intelligent substation construction by studying intelligent substation evaluation index system.

articleTitle: The design of intelligent music system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart home, a cheap and intelligent music system which is easy to install and operate will be of great concern. In this paper, the STM32F407ZET6 is used as micro-controller core of the control by the music system. Audio decoding module, SD card, Bluetooth audio receiver, radio module, audio source selection module, po-wer amplifier, etc. are included in this system. The intelligent music system can achieve multi sound source input function and selection of the music playback mode including local music playback in SD card, mobile phone APP control by WIFI wireless module, handheld devices with Bluetooth. With high fidelity amplifier circuit design, sound quality is pure. Also it has the radio function for users. After integrated debugging of software and hardware, the music system can meet the requires of the design.

articleTitle: Research on the method based on wavelet analysis of negative pressure for detection of gas pipeline leaking
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The leakage of urban gas pipeline will bring inevitable threats and the inestimable economic losses to people. In order to reduce the losses caused by the gas leakage to the people, it is necessary to detect leakage timely and accurately determine the location of leakage points. First of all, taking MATLAB7.0 as the development platform, using the wavelet transformation multi-resolution decomposition and reconstruction technology remove noise which from gas pipeline upstream and downstream gathering the negative pressure wave signal. Secondly, using the wavelet transformation quickly capture the singular point of negative pressure wave signal, and calculate the negative pressure wave time reaches from upstream and downstream. Finally, through the negative pressure wave method for calculating, and located the leakage point position.

articleTitle: Performance test of Taurus HPC system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: High performance computing system has become the strong support of scientific research due to the good cost performance ratio and scalability after pure science and experimental science, the performance tests help to find out the performance bottlenecks of HPC systems. How to evaluate the performance of a HPC system is the main purpose of this paper. A high-performance computing system with 16 CPU+GPU compute nodes has been constructed. HPL benchmark was used to evaluate the performance of CPU, GPU under different matrix scale Ns, computational nodes, block size NB of matrix etc, and an empirical formula of Ns value calculation was presented through lots of testings. A comprehensive storage I/O performance was tested with IOZone which is a professional file system's standard testing tool. The performance of CPU cluster reaches 93.5% of the system theoretical value and GPU cluster gets 80% of the theoretical value.

articleTitle: The application of level-set mesh simplification algorithm in digital cultural heritage
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In this paper the level-set method is introduced to mesh simplification of the three-dimensional model, especially for cultural heritage. First, constructs a signed distance function, the zero set of which define is the surface. Then, introduces a energy functional and minimizes it to derive a second order geometric partial differential equation (GPDE) in the level-set formulation. Thus, the mesh simplification process is transferred into volumetric diffusion process of an implicit model. This method is used for simplification of digitalization of large scene and relics in cultural heritage. Finally, the level-set mesh simplification algorithm are compared and analyzed with mesh simplification algorithm based on point-collapse on the visual quality and geometric error. The experiment shows that it can be applied any topology of mesh. Even model is large-scale simplified, it is still able to maintain a considerable number of important geometric features and better overall visual effect while maintaining a low error level.

articleTitle: A pipe leakage detection method for water floor warm system using multiple linear regression models
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper presented a multiple linear regression model to solve the leakage detection of warm water pipelines. The normal detection is to pressurize the pipes, where the disadvantage is the leakage can't be noticed in real time. Through the simulations under various conditions, the method is proven to detect leakage efficiently.

articleTitle: Thermal stress analysis of calibrating and cooling process for plastic profile in calibrator
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The stress and strain of the plastic profile generated during its calibrating and cooling in the calibrator will result in the deformation of the profile. The reversed deformation design of the calibrator cavity is an effective method to solve this problem. The thermal stress of the profile during its calibrating and cooling in calibrator is analyzed by the thermo-mechanical coupled numerical simulation technology in this paper. The profile deformed and deformations are determined to do the theoretical reversed deformation design of the calibrator cavity. The deformations of the profile are mapped to the reversed deformation contour of the cavity. It is generally in agreement with the experiential reversed deformation design. The theoretical reversed deformation design of the cavity obtained according to the thermo-mechanical coupled analysis of the profile is verified correctness.

articleTitle: Design of natural gas desulfurization control system based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The purification process of natural gas mainly includes four main steps: desulfurization, dehydration, and sulfur recovery and tail gas treatment. In this paper, the process flow of natural gas desulfurization and purification system is described. The hardware system of PLC is used as control core, and the PLC program of lower computer is designed, and the software is used to complete the monitoring program. By monitoring the temperature, pressure and other parameters in the process, the system can be operated safely and reliably by the lower computer program driver and the upper computer screen monitoring.

articleTitle: A novel subtractive clustering method by increasing and using new data samples
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Although traditional subtractive clustering method is one of popular unsupervised clustering algorithms, it cannot obtain the better clustering performance. In this paper, a novel subtractive clustering method by increasing and using new data samples is proposed. New data sample consist of some centers of the cores, and these cores are gained by constructing the neighborhood graph. These new data samples can help the proposed method improve the clustering performance. To investigate the effectiveness of our approach, Experiments are done on several datasets. Experimental results show that our proposed method can gain the better clustering accuracies that traditional subtractive clustering, k-means and fuzzy c-means.

articleTitle: Research and design of the interface in the food tracing system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: With the improvement of living standard, people pay more and more attention on food safety. Tracing the source of food is a way to monitor food safety. This paper describes the design and implementation of the tracing system, using MySQL and JAVA. The system is divided into three layers, which are the data layer, the intermediate layer and the presentation layer. The paper will mainly introduce the research and design of the intermediate layer. It prove the flexibility and the faster response speed of the system, by using three-tier architecture and database connection pool.

articleTitle: A change password attack resistant scheme for remote user authentication using smart card
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In 2011, Chen-Hsiang-Shil proposed an improved remote user authentication using smart card. Two years later, it's claimed by Chen-Tasi-Leu that Chen-Hsiang-Shil's scheme was easy to crack under off-line password guessing attack and trapped by the time synchronous problem. They improved the scheme of Chen-Hsiang-Shil's and announced that the new one can reduce the vulnerability and hold the merits. However, we found Chen-Tasi-Leu's scheme is still easy to crack under changing password attack. So, in this paper, we will firstly discuss the vulnerability of Chen-Tasi-Leu's scheme and then propose an improvement as solution.

articleTitle: BDI based stock prediction
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: It is difficult for investors to predict the stock market. The advance of computer science and technology makes it possible to process big data. For example, data mining has been used widely. In the meantime, searching engine is the most important tool in obtaining market information. Therefore, searching behavior might be a potential reason behind the trading of stock. Therefore, in this paper, we use the Baidu Index (BDI) and try to predict the volatility of stocks. Based on the data mining theory and the powerful R language, this paper found out the relationship between searched keywords and the volatility of stocks by building up a logistic regression model. For this purpose, we proposed a simple dictionary, which is a minor contribution of this paper.

articleTitle: An experimental study on the corrosion amount in RC structures by eddy current heating
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper presents a proof-of-concept experimental demonstration of the eddy heat imaging (EHI) estimation. The EHI estimation has the ability to provide an on-site measurement of the corrosion amount rather than corrosion rate in reinforced concrete (RC) structures without destruction. In the experiment, the relation between the surface temperature and the corrosion amount is investigated by means of a combination of eddy current and infrared (IR) imaging techniques. Preliminary results show that the EHI method is a promising approach for the quantitative measurement of the corrosion amount in RC structures.

articleTitle: A fiber-optic temperature sensor based on optical thin films
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This contribution proposes a novel fiber-optic sensor developed for temperature measurement based on optical thin films. The sensing element is the optical multi-layer thin film coated at the fiber end. The sensor exploits the displacement of the optical cut-off edge occurring in optical thin films under the influence of temperature variation as a result of temperature-induced reflectivity shifting of cut-off edge at the same wavelength. The structure of the sensor and the measurement principle are described. The accuracy of the sensor can be improved by choosing the material of high refractive index temperature coefficient. The sensor has been tested operate from room temperature to 100 degrees centigrade. It shows good repetition in this sensor. The sensor also demonstrated good stability during extended temperature cycling tests.

articleTitle: Stable-time prediction during incremental speech recognition
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Incremental speech recognition (ISR) is the key technology to increase the efficiency of human-computer interaction and obtain the good user experience. However, ISR's results are not stable. The earlier methods decide whether to output the current best partial result by stable-time. These methods can increase stability, but introduce a lag which lowers the advantage of user experience. In this paper, a new method based on the stable-time prediction is proposed. It predicts the probable stable-time of the current best partial result in the future, using the acoustic score information of N-best paths of successive frames. So it can determine whether to output the current best partial result in advance. It can reduce lags and improve performance. Results indicate that, the proposed method outperforms the baseline. At the lag of 0.2s, the proposed method results in an absolute improvement of 1.2% and achieves a stability of 92.2%. And at the other lags, the proposed method also results in a similar improvement.

articleTitle: An online spatio-temporal sudden pollution simulation system for the Songhua River, China
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The Songhua River Pollution Control Project is one of the most significant water-related environmental pollution control schemes in Northeastern China. This paper details the requirements, architecture, and main components of an online river sudden pollution simulation system (RSPSS) for scientific planning and decision making for a complicated natural river network. On the basis of a service-oriented method and spatiotemporal simulation technology, the following components are developed: multi-platform, multi-level, dynamic, and flexible data services; task services that can be used by other online ArcGIS Server Silverlight Projects; and integrated third-party hydrodynamic and water quality models, which can simulate complex river networks under natural hydrological and climatic conditions online. With the RSPSS, spatial and non-spatial datasets and functions are seamlessly integrated from distributed sources by standard services. Thus, this system can support effective cross-regional and cross-departmental decisions. A study of a real-world implementation of the suggested system involving the historical sudden pollution of the Songhua River based on the RSPSS is also presented.

articleTitle: The design of the multiple serial port communication based on BF561 platform
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In view of present using more and more serial communication and even not enough for embedded processor connected peripherals, this paper proposes multiple serial port communication design and implementation based on BF561 platform. With dual-core processor ADSP-BF561 as control core and uClinux as system software platform, using asynchronous serial communication chip TL16C554 by TI Co., Ltd, adopting the way of sharing interrupt to design and realize the multiple serial communication, saving valuable interrupt resources. This scheme successfully apply to the filed of wireless sensor networks for practical project.

articleTitle: An improved K-dominance method for QoS based service recommendation in cloud
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In the cloud computing environment, more and more functional-equivalent services are provided with different QoS levels by competitive provider, resulting to increasing importance of QoS-based service selection or recommendation. To cope with this multi-objective optimization problem, we first propose a novel improved k-dominance operator, i.e. the partial dominance score. By combining the partial dominance score and skyline computation, we redefine the optimization objective for the QoS based service recommendation. Then, we present an algorithm that can efficiently search and return top-k QoS optimal services in term of their partial dominance score. Finally, we evaluate the efficiency as well as the effectiveness of proposed algorithm through a set of experimental studies.

articleTitle: Study on prediction for fracturing operation noise and impact assessment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Fracturing is one of the key stimulation treatment techniques with wide application prospect for oil-gas well and is a kind of main form of natural gas exploitation currently, which is especially important for development of shale gas. However, the noise generated in the process of fracturing operation may impact the site operators and residents in the periphery. The typical fracturing operation process is selected in this paper to implement the actual measurement of noise and record such relevant parameters as operation condition and ambient environment. Based on the computation method of outdoor acoustic transmission attenuation, Cadna/A ambient noise simulation software is utilized to establish the acoustic environment simulation simplification model for certain oil well fracturing operation, implement the simulation study for noise impact distribution condition in the process of fracturing operation construction and perform the contrastive analysis for actually-measured value on the site. The result shows that the site operator's contact noise value is higher than the occupational exposure limit in National Occupational Sanitary Standard GBZ 2.2-2007 Occupational Exposure Limit for Harmful Factors in Workplace and the noise produced during operation in the daytime doesn't meet the emission limit in National Standard GB 12348-2008 Emission Standard for Ambient Noise at the Boundary of Industrial Enterprise. Therefore, in combination with the actual fracturing operation, the reasonable noise prevention and control measures are proposed. The study result of this paper has certain reference value for prediction and assessment of fracturing operation noise.

articleTitle: Key techniques analyses for improving the yield of 50mm diameter neutron tube
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: 50mm diameter neutron tube has been developed for many years in Northeast Normal University. The tube was designed as a sealed ceramic tube, and the maximum neutron yield of the neutron tube was 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>n/s, the design of neutron tube was based on the PIG ion source. To improve neutron yield, key techniques analyses are presented in this paper as follows: increase the acceleration voltage, enhance magnetic field intensity of ion source terminal, and optimize coating thickness of titanium target based on theoretic analyses and experiments. According to these analyses, neutron tube has been modified, test operation has been started. The improved 50mm diameter tube can achieve a performance goal of producing 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>n/s over a long lifetime, and its stability is better than 2%.

articleTitle: Study on tuning method of low excitation limit curve of Generator
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The low excitation limit curve of generator which is tuned correctly can helps to ensure the normal operation of generator, because the generator and power system will be separated if the voltage of auxiliary power is too low, loss of field protection is in operation or static stability of generator is not enough. This paper describes a tuning method of low excitation limit curve of Generator. Experiment proved that the method is practical and effective.

articleTitle: Analyzing of multi service backhaul network based on IP radio access network technology
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Basing on the optical transmission theory, the technology devolvement direction and long term evolution direction of fixed network and mobile bearer network status is analyzed. The business transformation of telecom business needs is discussed around the customer value and high quality network construction ideas. With the communication technology, the domestic IP RAN (Radio Access Network) bearer network is analyzed in detail. And the IP RAN bearing network service bearing network types and related properties are discussed, in order to provide relevant reference scheme for domestic bearing network construction. In this paper, this data transmission network system is studied using analytical approaches. We analytically calculate the variance of the phase rotation term for each subcarrier when the pilot subcarriers are uniformly distributed or centered over the signal transmission.

articleTitle: A performance evaluation method of research platform based on improved weight matrix
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Performance evaluation of research platform which is used to evaluate the theory application in the economic field which can reflect the future development of the business situation and forecast the prospects of research platform. Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to assess the research platform. Firstly, Analytic Hierarchy Process is applied to determine the weight of all factors in two levels and fuzzy relationship matrix, as well as the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation matrix. Secondly, an improved weight matrix is proposed to assess the appraisal of research platform better on the basis of fuzzy appraisal model. Lastly, data analysis is carried out and a conclusion that the quality of the evaluation method applied in this paper obtained. Performance evaluation is widely used in the field of sports, manufacture and education, which is a key point to enhance the performance of various enterprises and give a better understanding of the effect in the field.

articleTitle: Analysis and comparison of reliability models based on software architecture
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In the test phase of software development, using only the software reliability growth model for software troubleshooting is not perfect the software reliability growth model is useable for software trouble shooting, yet also inadequate. The paper analyzes two stages of software development based on the framework of reliability model, compares their advantages and disadvantages, and then proposes the direction of further building software reliability model.

articleTitle: Developing a simulation model to analyze short range air defense precision of warship based on combining warship gun with air defense missile
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper aims at analyzing the error influences on the precision of combining ship gun with air defense missile system. The structure and subsystem model of simulation system is designed firstly. Considering the combination of air defense missile and warship gun, optimized procedure of intercepting target is proposed to transform air defense firepower. Based on the platform of simulation system, various kinds of errors of air defense system are analyzed in order to study the effectiveness of attacking target. Finally, the precision of simulation system is calculated through the simulation model to prove that the design scheme is effective and can be a reference to the practical ship-based air defense system design.

Author Keywords: Combined Ship Gun with Air Defense Missile

articleTitle: A DNN for small leakage detection of positive pressure gas pipelines in the semiconductor manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: To solve the small leakage detection of positive pressure gas pipelines in the semiconductor manufacturing, a deep neural network (DNN) was proposed based on sound signal. For dealing with sound signals as suitable inputs, a pre-process model was designed for de-noising and features extraction. And a DNN with four layers was built for training and learning the sound signals, to precisely and quickly detect the sound of small leakage of pipelines. By the simulated results, they show the presented DNN gained a good percentage of detection than normal neural network (NN). And the learning rate and numbers of neurons in each layer are significant parameters for the model. It is so important that our method provides a novel way for any small leakage detection of positive pressure gas pipelines by involving sound signals.

articleTitle: An automatic approach to “De, Di, De” of spelling errors detection in Chinese text
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: “De, Di, De” is related to the part-of-speech of the first previous word and the first following word, so their spelling errors can bring trouble to Chinese information processing. This paper propose an automatic approach to “De, Di, De” of spelling errors check. The new method can construct the statistical model of the context, and use this model to detection “De, Di, De” of spelling errors in Chinese text. Experiments are done on one noise free simplified Chinese dataset, one noise free traditional Chinese dataset and one traditional Chinese dataset with noise. The results show that the proposed approach based on the statistical model can achieve the better performance than the detection method based rules.

articleTitle: Application research of flocking control algorithm in target tracking of hybrid mobile sensor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Aiming at the target tracking problem of hybrid mobile sensor network in obstacle avoidance, a kind of hybrid mobile sensor network target tracking algorithm based on flocking control is proposed. The algorithm can make the velocity of mobile sensor in the system asymptotically converge to target velocity, and keep an expected distance with the target; in the tracking process, the connectivity of network topology is always guaranteed, while avoiding any obstacle to prevent collision. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good performance in obstacle avoidance and target tracking.

articleTitle: A three-dimensional audio signal generating method for aspheric loudspeaker array
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: 3D audio technology has been coming gradually into the market with its use in the film industry. However, the existing 3D-audio generating methods are based on the spherical loudspeaker array. Given that a typical family can hardly allow a spherical loudspeaker array, the current algorithms have impeded the progress of the popularization and the development of the multimedia industry to some extent. In this paper, we propose a novel method which is available for the aspherical loudspeaker array. Based on the physical properties of sound signals in air, the proposed method develops a 3D-audio signal generating and distributing model, through which the 3D effect in irregular loudspeaker array can be reproduced. Our preliminary results show that there are no obvious differences between the original source and the virtual source reproduced by our model.

articleTitle: Mining miRNAs2target genes interactions from biomedical literature
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This work describes an approach to mine miRNAs2target genes interactions related to breast cancer from literature. First, the work obtain 53 miRNAs and 2130 protein-coding genes regarding to the breast cancer, then using prior knowledge to extract the relationship between miRNAs and protein-coding genes, we achieved 2231 miRNAs2target interactions finally. We also constructed a miRNAs2target network, which could be used to clearly show the extracted miRNAs2target interactions.

articleTitle: On the face recognition with orthogonal bidirectional discriminant supervised projection
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: By combining the discriminant supervised LPP with the orthogonal bidirectional projection, an orthogonal bidirectional discriminant supervised LPP (OBDSLPP), was proposed in which the left and right projection matrices for OBDSLPP are orthogonal. In this algorithm, to get the matrices, one trace ratio optimization problem are required to be solved. Experimental results show that the proposed OBDSLPP achieve more higher recognition accuracy than 2DDLPP, 2DDSLPP and BDLPP, respectively.

articleTitle: A research of key technology used in seafood traceability
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Seafood safety is widely concerned. Traceability of seafood solves the people's concerns about food quality. Traceability needs to collect information operating on this seafood of every stage during processing. This article presents a traceability system from seafood breading, processing and sales logistics. Based on this system, advanced technology is adopted to ensures its efficiency and improve the management of information flow within the supply chain and security in the seafood sector. The combination of QRcode, RFID(Radio Frequency Identification), barcode and image preprocessing enhances accuracy and efficiency of operation and information collection.

articleTitle: A fast parallel large-scale grid generator for parallel computing in engineering simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Due to the limitation of memory and time, the traditional serial grid generation algorithms are usually the bottleneck to make the distributed computing be widely used in engineering science. To solve this problem and make the true large-scale parallel simulation in engineering science practical, a fast parallel grid generation algorithm has been proposed and the corresponding grid generator has been developed. Firstly, the initial coarse volume mesh is generated by using advancing front method. Then, two-level domain decomposition is applied and each subdomain is distributed to its corresponding process. By doing so, the intra-node and inter-node communication are distinguished and the communication overheads are reduced. Lastly, the mesh refinement algorithm is performed to generate large-scale grids without communication. Applications of the proposed algorithm and the developed generator for large-scale grid generation on supercomputer (TIANHE-2) are carried out. The reasonably good parallel scalability is obtained and the effectiveness and correctness of the developed generator are verified.

articleTitle: The reserch of variable structure fuzzy neural network control system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The three-layer fuzzy neural network with variable structure applies the overall variable structure algorithm. The learning ability of fuzzy neural network with variable structure helps to extract fuzzy rules from the data automatically. Fuzzy neural network with variable structure changes the structure in training, and it improves the learning speed and convergence performance of the neural network. The fuzzy neural network with variable structure achieves systematic design of the fuzzy system by changing structure in training. It avoids the randomness of the fuzzy system design. Variable structure algorithm applies to the control system can effectively improve the convergence speed of fuzzy neural network. Simulation results show that the fuzzy neural network with variable control system has the advantage of fast convergence in training fuzzy control rules. Mean square error and error rate converges rapidly than traditional fuzzy neural network.

articleTitle: Moving objects data model based on multi-scale road networks
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Data management for moving objects on road networks has become a hot topic research recently years. Moving objects have different running characteristics in different scales of road networks, but existing data models on moving objects haven't consider multi-scale characteristics in road networks. The concepts such as multi-scale moving objects trajectories, multi-scale moving objects locations are defined in the paper. This paper presents moving objects data model based on multi-scale road networks, and realizes representation for moving objects in multi-scale road networks.

articleTitle: Gait recognition based on feature fusion and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Facing the problem that the recognition rate based on single feature algorithm is low in present gait recognition studying, a new gait recognition algorithm based on feature fusion and support vector machine is proposed. First, getting the body contour image by using background subtraction, then extracting the human body contour line and using Fourier descriptor to express human body contour feature, extracting limb angles feature, also introducing a kind of dynamic regional variance feature. Fusing them to get a combination features vector and finally using support vector machine to classify the vector. A plenty of experiments are made on the CASIA gait databases. Experimental results show the high recognition rate of this method.

articleTitle: Design of the sample pretreatment system for flue gas on-line analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Nowadays, the technology of flue gas on-line analysis in different circumstances need to use different pretreatment system, which is not conducive to the promotion of on-line analysis techniques. According to the principle of “ cold dry process” to design an online analysis of flue gas sample pretreatment system, which can be achieved sampling and sample pretreatment in the slight positive pressure or negative pressure environment, ultimately meet the requirements of most of online infrared analyzer.

articleTitle: A FPGA-based processing circuit design and realization for baseband signals of RFID
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper analyzes a newly-developed circuit with Nios soft core as a processing circuit for baseband signals, however the current baseband circuit for RFID is on the basis of ARM or DSP which is cumbersome and not easily to update. This newly-developed FPGA-based circuit is flexible in structure and easy to update by using software to design circuit. This new circuit will be widely adaptable to different chips and communication mechanisms as parameters in software change accordingly, and thus provides a favoriable condition for further improvement of the circuit.

articleTitle: Design of constant pressure water supply system for a residential district based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The stability, reliability and economy of water supply system directly affect the normal work and life of the users, and it also reflects the management level of the water supply system. According to the energy saving principle of the frequency conversion and energy saving of water supply system, the design scheme of the automatic control system of the upper computer with PLC as the controller and the frequency converter is presented. From the hardware selection, circuit design, the lower computer control program, the upper computer monitor screen and so on to make a detailed demonstration and design. Through on-line debugging of the constant pressure water supply system, the system has the advantages of strong stability, reliability, operation convenience, good monitoring and so on.

articleTitle: Wind-solar hybrid streetlights monitoring system networking optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: A networking optimization strategy, ZigBee Serial Network is put forward, in order to make up the disadvantage of ZigBee Mesh network and realize real-time effective monitoring for wind-solar hybrid streetlights. A wireless monitoring system is designed based on ZigBee Serial Network and 3G technology. ZigBee Serial Network only has Full Function Device nodes, which has the advantages of stable transmission, wide covered area, easy to change failure modules. It is suitable for wind-solar hybrid streetlights monitoring or remote serial data transmission. Its structure and building mode is introduced. ZigBee and 3G modules, software process, ultimately experiments and engineering application results of the monitoring system are provided. It shows that ZigBee Serial Network is stable, low packet loss rate, and the monitoring system is low cost, easy to realize, accurately reflecting running state of the streetlights. It has a wide application prospect for wind-solar hybrid streetlights in the future.

articleTitle: A kind of personalized search method based on the information extraction
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This article serves to provide users with personalized search service based on the information extraction technology hidden in the network resources. This paper established a model of personalized search through the Task Schema to realize user requests to the mapping of the Task instance, and put forward the personalized results integration strategy based on user goals to achieve the goal of optimizing users search.

articleTitle: Safety detection and interlock alarm system for online analyzer house
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: This paper was prepared to make analysis on the need for safety monitoring on concentration overturn of hazardous gas that happened in the online analyzer house in petrochemical engineering.
