This was achieved by introducing a PLC (programmable logic controller) based safety interlocking and monitoring system including its structure and realization of interlocking logic. The system delivers real-time automatic monitoring and interlocking control on concentration overturn of hazardous gas, being able to satisfy the need for automated management in industrial processes.

articleTitle: Face recognition: A novel un-supervised convolutional neural network method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Image classification is an effortless task for humans but when it comes to learn by a machine it's fairly challenging. Convolutional neural network (CNN) as one of the most prevalent deep learning algorithm, has gain high reputation in Image features extraction. In this research article, we propose few new twists of unsupervised learning i.e. sparse filtering to seizure effective and distinguishable features of image. Features extracted by sparse filtering algorithm is convolved with the first CNN layer, and then these feature are further used in feed forward manner by the CNN to learn more good features for classification. The linear regression classifier is used to serve as the output layer of CNN for providing the probability of image class. We show that the performance of numeral visual identification and detection tasks improves by using these filters in multistage convolutional network architecture i.e. CNN. As far as we are concern, this is the first effort where an unsupervised convolutional neural network has been introduced to the facial classification problem. Experimental results on a public dataset determine the efficiency of the proposed model. Moreover, we conclude this paper by pinpointing some open research issues for face image classification in future contemplation.

articleTitle: Economic optimal model integrating statistical process control and preventive maintenance
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Under the assumption that the process shift and equipment failure are two different but dependent stochastic processes, and the failure rate increases when the process is out of control, an economic optimal approach by integrating statistical process control and preventive maintenance is proposed. First, five scenarios are defined. By the cost structure analysis and the reliability theory, the cycle cost, cycle time and occurrence probability are then calculated and the integrated model to minimize the expected cost within unit time is set up based on the renewal reward process. A genetic algorithm is designed to solve this model. Finally, several comparative experiments are designed. The results show that this method is superior to other method such as the integrated corrective and plan maintenance model with respect to the cost saving. And other important conclusions are also drawn.

articleTitle: Evenly-distributed clustering for wireless sensor network: A scalable, energy-efficient approach
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Users can accurately monitor a remote field conveniently with a wireless sensor network (WSN), whereas the sensor nodes deployed in WSN are extremely power-constrained and are nearly impossible to recharge due to the harsh conditions of monitoring areas. Thus, lifetime of the network becomes the most significant factor in WSN designment. Clustering is an energy-effective network management technique, since its hierarchical structure reduces the total energy consumption of the whole network. In this paper, we develop and analyze the Evenly Distributed Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (EDACH), a clustering algorithm devoted to maximizing lifetime of WSN by periodically creating proper new clusters evenly distributed in the monitoring field, which exploits distributed method to create clusters and uses level-based flooding technology to exchange data with sink node so that centralized management and long range data transmission are not required. Moreover, EDACH selects cluster heads with high residual energy which will not be too close or too distant to other cluster heads. EDACH can balance the energy consumption of each single node in WSN and thus avoids any nodes depleting its energy too early. Experimental results show that EDACH can effectively prolong the lifetime of network.

articleTitle: Provide multilingual support for enterprise systems with cloud-based transparent proxy
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Current enterprises have to cater the needs of employees and customers from different countries. Rendering the information systems to present in multiple languages becomes an inevitable issue for multinational enterprises. The objective of this research is to develop a framework that promotes the use of cloud computing and network proxy to provide a flexible and efficient multilingual solution. The proposed solution allows appending multi-language support to existing enterprise systems with minimum changes and maximum scalability through a translation cloud. Finally, an experimental system is designed as an illustration for the implementation of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis of three dynamic ID-based remote user authentication schemes using smart cards
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: Remote user authentication is a mechanism in which the remote server verifies the legitimacy of a user over an open and insecure communication channel. Password authentication using a smart card has been one of the commonly adopted methods to protect the password during transmission. Recently, many researchers have proposed a series of dynamic ID-based remote user authentication schemes with the feature that the user's identity is changed in every transaction session. In this paper, we introduce three recent proposed authentication schemes using smart cards, and point out some weaknesses in these schemes such as smart card forge attacks, impersonation attack, message forge attack, replay attack and resembling account attack, etc. Furthermore, some advanced topics about dynamic ID-based authentication scheme are discussed and demonstrated which is useful for the authentication scheme designers.

articleTitle: Multi-expert decision making using rough-fuzzy rule interpolation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: The goal in multi-expert decision making is to ensure that the best decision is made with respect to the available information and knowledge possessed by all experts. However, different types of uncertainty may influence both the assessment of the individual views and the derivation of the overall group-level solution. The difficulty in such multi-expert decision making may escalate if the views of all individuals only cover part of the problem space. Systems capable of reasoning through fuzzy rule interpolation can help. Fuzzy rule interpolation is an important technique for performing inference with sparse rule bases. Even when a given observation has no overlap with the antecedent values of any existing rules, fuzzy rule interpolation may still derive a conclusion. This paper presents an approach for achieving multi-expert decision making via fuzzy rule interpolation. Individual preferences are firstly aggregated by means of a method learned on rough-fuzzy set theory, and rough-fuzzy rule interpolation is then applied to derive the group-level conclusion. An application to real datasets is carried out and the results are presented to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed work in guaranteeing the overall decision accuracy.

articleTitle: Allocation model of reliability based on synergy principle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: In common cases, the entropy of multi-source information depends only on the source itself, or put it another way, during the process of fusion information, any introduction of algorithm or model to the system cannot reduce the entropy below the minimum of system entropy, which is the intrinsic problem of probability assignment function. In this paper, we provide a way to implement the allocation of reliability based on synergy principle, which not only reduce the impact of measuring error on allocation of reliability, but minimize the uncertainty of the system composed of multi-source information as well. The algorithm redistributes the multi-source information system according to overlapping conditions of confidence interval, and quantifies the reliability by utilizing the principle that different pieces of consistent information increase the reliability of others mutually and the synergy principle. Thus, this synergistic allocation way of reliability will both reduce transmission error produced by the fusion and calculation process of information markedly and improve the reliability of classification results. We will show how the algorithm improves the performance of fusion process of sea surface temperature measured by multiple satellites in this paper.

articleTitle: Keynote speech 1: Online machine learning for big data analytics by cognitive robots
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference of Online Analysis and Computing Science (ICOACS)
abstract: It is recognized that both sources of and solutions to the big data challenges are human collective intelligence. Data are an abstract representation of the quantity of realistic entities and perceived objects. Big data play an indispensable role not only in a wide range of engineering applications, but also in the cognitive mechanisms of both humans and cognitive robots such as sensation, quantification, qualification, estimation, memory, and reasoning. This keynote lecture presents online big data analytic theories by machine learning as well as knowledge extraction by cognitive robotics. Data, information, knowledge, and intelligence are the four hierarchical layers of cognitive objects in the brain and cognitive systems from the bottom up. It is discovered by the author that, although the cognitive unit of data is bit, that of knowledge is bir, i.e., a binary relation. A resent finding towards big data science is that big data systems in nature are a recursive n-dimensional typed hyperstructure (RNDTHS). This topological property of big data reveals that the mathematical foundation of big data science is underpinned by big data algebra (BDA), which is a denotational mathematical structure for efficiently dealing with the inherited complexities and unprecedented challenges in big data engineering. This leads to a coherent theory for big data modeling, analyses, mining, information elicitation, knowledge extraction, and intelligent generation for cognitive robots. Latest experiments demonstrate that cognitive robots may autonomously transform big data in vast linguistic databases (corpuses) into sophistic knowledge bases by cognitive machine learning.
